cli.cmd_doctor: Check that every tool Bumpproof needs is installed and logged in
cli.cmd_init: Write .bumpproof/config.json and draft journeys for an app
cli.cmd_check: Compare the base and head of a bump in a real browser
cli.cmd_fix: Let the coding agent fix a regression, then verify again
cli.cmd_pr: Run the whole loop on a pull request
cli.cmd_census: Run the census over third-party pull requests
cli.cmd_report: Build the report site in docs/
cli.cmd_replay: Replay a recorded run in the terminal, offline
cli.not_built: The '{name}' command is not built yet.
cli.disabled: Bumpproof is disabled in config ("enabled": false). Nothing to do.
cli.opt_base: Base ref for check (branch, tag or commit)
cli.opt_dir: App folder inside the repository (default: config app.dir)

doctor.title: Bumpproof doctor
doctor.node_old: {found} is older than the required major {min}

outcome.baseline_red: Fails on the base branch too

reason.base_build_failed: The base branch did not build or start.
reason.no_baseline_journey: No journey passed on the base branch.
reason.head_build_failed: The pull request did not build or start.
reason.regression: A journey that passes on the base branch fails on the pull request.
reason.all_inconclusive: Kane CLI could not finish any journey on the pull request.
reason.ok: Every journey behaves as it does on the base branch.

check.title: Bumpproof check: {base} → {head}
check.side_ok: {side}: installed, built and answering on the port after {s} s
check.head_skipped: Head not started: the base must build first.
check.outcome_both_built: Result: both sides build and start.
check.outcome_head_build_failed: Result: the bump does not build or start. This counts as a failed build.
check.outcome_base_build_failed: Result: could not run. The base does not build or start, so there is nothing to compare against.
check.journeys_not_run: Browser journeys were not run in this check.

sandbox.failed_health: the app started but did not answer HTTP in time
sandbox.plan_no_package_json: no package.json in the app folder
sandbox.plan_no_lockfile: no lockfile (package-lock.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml), so the install cannot be pinned
sandbox.plan_no_serve: no way to serve the app: set app.serve in .bumpproof/config.json
sandbox.plan_unknown: the app could not be planned
sandbox.refused_docker: Docker refused to start the container ({detail})
